verdict.rationale: Snyk documents AI-generated suggestions drawn from the user's own code and projects: DeepCode AI security autofixes, AI-supported context-aware risk scoring, and an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that builds fix plans enriched with Snyk security intelligence. However, the agentic experience mainly runs in external coding assistants or the CLI, and the docs do not show general AI insights over the user's data inside the Snyk platform itself. missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or summaries within Snyk's own UI or dashboard, broader AI analysis beyond vulnerability fixes and risk scoring, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: DeepCode AI powers 85%-accurate security autofixes and comprehensive app coverage
DeepCode AI supports Snyk’s context-aware risk scoring, assessing the popularity of the affected package and the reachability of vulnerable code
The Remediation Agent is an LLM-driven tool that automates vulnerability remediation in your projects. It scans your Project with Snyk, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence
all in your coding assistant or the Snyk CLI
